quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：turnserver 命令行参数，按运行后留下的文件名差分判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/coturn/vulnerability_WF_RAG_0/args.txt; adapted: the arguments of the exploit's second turnserver run, as the conversion replay recorded them (-n --simple-log -l /tmp/exploit_work/my_simple_log, cwd /tmp/exploit_work), one per line; the first run (without --simple-log) gives the dated name in both builds and is dropped)

ground_truth.how_found: c5_specs.json: newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/coturn/vulnerability_WF_RAG_0/args.txt; adapted: the arguments of the exploit's second turnserver run, as the conversion replay recorded them (-n --simple-log -l /tmp/exploit_work/my_simple_log, cwd /tmp/exploit_work), one per line; the first run (without --simple-log) gives the dated name in both builds and is dropped

review.note: a complex log file name is created despite --simple-log

category5.design: The injected change only changes the names of the log files turnserver creates (--simple-log is ignored), so the rule compares the names of the files the run leaves below /tmp and /var/tmp (dates and turn_<pid>_ normalized) after the judge stops the daemon at 5 s; the output is not compared because it carries times and pids and could echo files that differ between the builds.
